goal: Ask GPT Pro for next geometry optimization directions, not another data-summary pass.
scope: W2 510.58-511.42 keV raw TES background candidates and post-processing audits; no new transport run.
why_this_regrouping: The previous complement package was very data-heavy. This regrouping adds CAD-like geometry context and keeps the event-level particle/veto evidence needed for optimization reasoning.

atm511_source_definition.name: Atm511LowerUnit3M_GeoOptS1BpeW5
atm511_source_definition.interpretation: Lower-hemisphere 511-keV line source, not a full-4pi isotropic source.

veto_priority_definition: non_plastic_active_veto if CsI/BGO/other active edep >= 50 keV and not plastic veto
compton_fov_veto if side_compton_fov_pass is false and no active veto

entry_definition.frame: local detector frame after rotate_y(world_direction, -45 deg)
entry_definition.phi_local_deg: atan2(dir_local_y, dir_local_x), 0..360 deg; side-window axis proxy is local phi=180 deg +/-15 deg

major_caveats: BPE effect is not isolated by a no-BPE A/B transport; current evidence is for the S1/BPE/W5 shield stack.
Plastic-off means post-processing veto accounting off; plastic material remains in transport.
Entry window is a proxy based on envelope crossing near local negative-X side-window axis, not a CAD boundary scorer.
Neutron depth table uses first-hit depth proxy, not continuous energy-loss-vs-depth scoring.
